## Problem

What user problem would this solve?

## Proposed solution

## Alternatives considered

## Security impact

Does this touch files, commands, provider requests, secrets, permissions or network access?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Works on Windows 10/11 x64
- [ ] Works in Persian RTL and Finglish/Latin-only modes
- [ ] Has tests or a clear manual test plan
- [ ] Does not require mandatory cloud services or telemetry
